what_this_is: The signed-off build every later change is measured against (owner, 2026-10-02: 'start with the guard and baseline'). A change that alters the model's view fails test_the_models_view_is_the_baselines until the sign-off set is re-run on it and matches or beats the results below; only then is this file moved to the new build.

promoted.what_this_is: How this baseline replaced the one before it (design §40.3): recorded as the named candidate, deployed, and measured by the sign-off set before it was relied on.
promoted.change: Claude Opus 5.5: model claude-opus-5-5; effort low (Opus 5.5 always thinks; the signed-off build ran with the intent tool forced, so no thinking); the intent tool asked for in the prompt, not forced (Opus 5.5 rejects a forced call), and asked once more if a response has no call; server-side fallback on a safety-classifier decline; max_tokens 16000 for the thinking. The prompts, the catalogue and the tool schema are unchanged.
promoted.compared_with_previous: Every must-answer and held-out must-answer answer (163) word for word the previous baseline's; the variants scored the same (78 / 1 / 2, the two different readings the ones accepted at the previous sign-off); 14 differences, all fine-to-decline or nice-to-have: forecast_015 and forecast_016 asked back rather than answered, the 12-week completion run rate answered (§40.2), and the rest declines or ask-backs in other words. Median 8.8s a question (9.1s).
promoted.contract_fixes_measured_with_it: §40.1 named periods and grouped distribution; §40.2 the completion run-rate on the pipeline base

previous.what_this_is: The baseline this one replaced. Claude Opus 5 stays supported (retirement not before 2027-07-24); returning to it is a change of view like any other, measured the same way.

conversation_reader.what_this_is: The conversation reader's view (design §39): everything it is shown for every message. It turns a follow-up or a reply into one complete question for the interpreter above, whose view is unchanged. Pinned like the interpreter's: a change to it fails test_the_models_view_is_the_baselines until the conversation bank is re-run on it and matches or beats the results recorded here.
conversation_reader.rules: 1.1.0 (§39.1): a new grouping replaces the earlier one however the message opens, and is added only when the message says so (D25); a change taken back is the earlier question without it; the reader asks only what a message refers to, never what it means
